lines.text: ChatGPT now recommends businesses. Is yours on it?

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Since November tenth, you can claim your business profile. For free.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Step one. Log in, and open Business Hub: chatgpt.com/business-hub

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Step two. Search your business, and tap Get Started.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Step three. Prove it's yours, with your phone, email, website, or Shopify.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Step four. A quick ID check, and you get the blue check.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Then add your prices and stock, and see how often ChatGPT mentions you.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Online businesses can claim anywhere ChatGPT works. Local shops, US listings for now.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Comment CHATGPT, and I'll send you the full checklist. Follow @nxtlvlsocial.ai for more.
